AN ORIGINAL JURASSIC ENGLISH STORY
Mango, the Market Cat
Level 2 · Development Ages 8–10 Story + Workbook
JurassicEnglish.com · Storybook workbook edition

Chapter 1
1 A new street
Dan and his mum moved to the city in the rainy season. Their small
flat was above a busy street market. Here, he knew nobody.
On the third day, he saw an orange cat asleep on the noodle stall.
Her fur was the colour of a ripe mango.
‘Hello, Mango,’ Dan whispered. He gave her some fish. ‘You can be
my cat.’
Read and circle
Where did Dan first see the cat?
A. On the noodle stall
B. In the fruit baskets
C. On his own step
